parent_objective: run a no-training geometry-first source pipeline smoke after materializer and enrichment implementation
blocked_by: source pipeline has not yet been run on public M1419 source rows after trace-backed geometry and source-step enrichment implementation
supersedes: M1425 reveal-step pressure rows as the source pool

public_gates: M1443 must run source materialization and source-step action enrichment only
M1443 must not run source preflight bounded replay outcome interventions train PPO promote use private holdout export corpus or change actor inputs
M1443 must report materialized source geometry counts and selected enriched rows
forbidden_shortcuts: do not use M1425 reveal-step pressure metrics as source-step action evidence

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: runs trace-backed source geometry materialization and source-step action enrichment on public M1419 rows before source preflight
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: source-pipeline smoke only; no source preflight, replay, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if trace-backed materialization produces zero source geometry rows
stop if enrichment produces zero selected action-divergent history rows
stop if source_body_x geometry remains too late for M1438/M1431 gates
stop if run requires actor input changes or stale M1425 metric reuse
fallback_plan: route to source-pipeline result audit if source materialization or enrichment gates fail
route to branch synthesis before M1438 row-level forward miner smoke if source pipeline passes
route to branch synthesis if the source pipeline exposes another missing layer
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1442 implements source-step enrichment and admits public source-pipeline smoke

training_stage.stage_objective: geometry-first source materialization and action-divergence enrichment smoke
admission_evidence: M1440 implements trace-backed source geometry materializer
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up branch synthesis manifest before row-level forward miner smoke or audit manifest
next_stage_criteria: source geometry and diversity summaries are recorded

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1443 source-pipeline smoke does not prove history necessity because it measures action divergence before outcome replay.
history_necessity_tests: future bounded replay must test whether selected history variants affect outcome
source-step action divergence alone cannot count as history-positive outcome evidence
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If selected enriched rows are zero, route to audit rather than lowering geometry gates or claiming no-history evidence.
allowed_claims: no replay result, promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The geometry-first source pipeline can materialize forward source geometry and then produce source-step action-divergent history rows on public M1419 rows without stale M1425 metric reuse.
success_criteria: materialized source geometry rows are nonzero
no source preflight replay training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export or actor-input change occurs
failure_criteria: materialized source geometry rows are zero
run uses M1425 reveal-step pressure metrics as source-step evidence
run starts source preflight replay training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export or actor-input change
decision_rule: M1443 passes if the no-training source pipeline produces nonzero materialized geometry and selected enriched action-divergent history rows without running preflight or replay, then routes through workflow synthesis before row-level mining.
